title: My day
description: Describe a typical day with times and everyday verbs.

blocks.text: To say at what time you do something, use o followed by the hour as an ordinal number: o szóstej (at six), o siódmej (at seven), o ósmej (at eight). In the I form, most verbs end in -ę or -m: wstaję (I get up), idę (I go), pracuję (I work), jem (I eat), wracam (I come back).

blocks.note: After do, praca becomes pracy (the genitive case).

blocks.translation: I come back home at five.
In the evening I watch television.

lines.speaker: Ola
lines.translation: What time do you get up?

lines.speaker: Ola
lines.text: Ja wstaję o szóstej, bo zaczynam pracę o siódmej.
lines.translation: I get up at six, because I start work at seven.
